name: Garbage, Recycling & Yard Waste

missed.rule: Report within 24 hours of your collection day (not for holiday or posted delays), or items wait until the next scheduled pickup.

director.name: Michael Rattler
director.title: Director of Transportation and Environmental Services

cartology.about: CARTology is the City's free collection calendar: look up your pickup days, get reminders, and search how to get rid of almost anything.

services.name: Garbage
tips: Bag your garbage and close the lid.

services.name: Recycling
tips: Garbage mixed in means it won't be collected.

services.name: Yard waste
tips: Bag leaves and yard waste, except during loose-leaf season.
Dark or white bags: leave open. See-through bags: tie shut.

services.name: Bulky items
tips: Up to 5 cubic yards; 50 lb per item.
No hazardous waste or construction debris.

services.name: White goods (appliances)
tips: Stoves, refrigerators, freezers, water heaters, dishwashers, washers and dryers.
Remove refrigerator and freezer doors; owner must remove the freon.

services.name: E-waste
tips: Computers, TVs, printers, scanners, phones, microwaves and stereos.
Not accepted: automotive electronics or large industrial equipment.

set_out: Put everything at the curb the night before your collection day.
Bring empty carts in by 7 a.m. the day after.
Keep carts, yard waste and bulky items 5 feet from each other and from cars, mailboxes, poles, fences and other obstructions.
delay_rule: Garbage, recycling, bulky items, white goods and e-waste are collected on every holiday except Thanksgiving and Christmas. Those weeks, pickups from the holiday on run one day late, through Saturday.

leaf_season.about: Loose-leaf vacuum season: rake leaves to the curb, no bags needed. CARTology shows your loose-leaf day.

christmas_trees: Real trees: remove decorations and lights, put at the curb on your yard-waste day. Artificial trees: same, on your recycling day (bulky pickup).
cart_note: Carts aren't replaced for odor or bugs; residents keep them clean.

elsewhere.detail: Paint, oil, batteries, propane cylinders, fluorescent bulbs and more go to the Cabarrus County Household Hazardous Waste Facility.
Don't flush it or trash it. Ask your pharmacy about a medication drop box.
Report animals hit by cars along the road to Public Works (weekends: leave a message, option 1). Pets and animals off the right-of-way aren't collected.
The City also collects garbage and recycling for businesses.
